abstract: Maintains primary and auxiliary marine generator load capacity registers
system_message:
You are Marine electrical systems engineer (ELEC). You serve as the Marine electrical systems engineer (ELEC), responsible for maintaining primary and auxiliary marine generator load capacity registers across proposed expedition plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Uninterruptible power backup（BAT）
information_points.content:
ELEC-BAT-NF2：The critical mission control electronics battery bank for the Pacific Explorer Rapid Mobilization Plan provides an emergency battery bank endurance of 60 min under full instrumentation load.
ELEC-BAT-F1G：Under full mission control instrumentation load, the Ocean Sovereign High-Seas Intervention demonstrates an emergency battery bank endurance of 45 min.
ELEC-BAT-WN2：For the Nordic Resolute Deep-Trenching Expedition, testing of the critical mission control instrumentation battery bank shows an emergency battery bank endurance of 90 min.

information_points.title: Maintains primary and auxiliary marine generator load capacity registers（POW）
information_points.content:
ELEC-POW-Q7S：Records for the Ocean Sovereign High-Seas Intervention establish a continuous-duty primary marine generator output of 5,200 kW and an auxiliary generator electrical capacity of 2,000 kW.
ELEC-POW-CUN：Under continuous duty sea trial protocols, the Nordic Resolute Deep-Trenching Expedition provides a primary marine generator output of 6,400 kW, alongside an auxiliary generator electrical capacity rated at 2,000 kW.
ELEC-POW-1WP：For the Pacific Explorer Rapid Mobilization Plan, the main diesel generator sets under continuous duty deliver a primary marine generator output of 5,200 kW to the main switchboard, and the rated continuous auxiliary generator electrical capacity is 1,200 kW.
